subject: Middle School Assignment Policy
overview: The Medford School Committee approved a 50/50 randomized lottery assignment plan for middle schools to balance economic and demographic disparities between McGlynn and Andrews Middle Schools. The committee also received reports on district math learning walks, recognized student and donor contributions, and reviewed emergency preparedness procedures for students with disabilities.

items.title: Approval of Minutes, Bills, and Payrolls
items.summary: The committee approved the minutes of the February 4, 2019 meeting along with bills, fund transfers, and payrolls.

items.title: Jingle Bell Road Race Fund Distribution
items.summary: Organizers distributed $31,809 in proceeds from the annual Jingle Bell Road Race to representatives of local schools and student programs.

items.title: Recognition of Columbus Elementary Student Writers
items.summary: The committee recognized fifth-grade students from Columbus Elementary School whose 100-word stories were selected for publication in "Spooky Saga Massachusetts Authors."

items.title: Recognition of Student Accomplishments in Music
items.summary: Fine Arts Director Tony Szykniej recognized student Catherine Schmidt for her selection to the MMEA Junior Festival cello section and Arden Ingersoll for making the Massachusetts All-State music ensemble.

items.title: Recognition of Class of 1965 Contributions
items.summary: Superintendent Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent and Class of 1965 President Sharon Deyeso recognized alumni for their ongoing fundraising to provide bus passes and school supplies for students in need.

items.title: Proposal for Subcommittee Budget Review
items.summary: A proposal to conduct detailed school budget reviews through the personnel subcommittee was tabled for formal placement on a future agenda.

items.title: Report of the Support Services Subcommittee
items.summary: Subcommittee Chair Paul Ruseau reported that a proposed policy was referred to the full subcommittee for further review.

items.title: Superintendent's Updates and Comments
items.summary: Superintendent Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent shared a video on mathematics learning walks and gave district updates, after which the committee voted to refer the technology use policy to the rules subcommittee.

items.title: Report on Fifth to Sixth Grade Transition Plan
items.summary: The committee approved a randomized 50/50 lottery system for assigning fifth-grade students to McGlynn and Andrews Middle Schools to address economic and demographic imbalance, while limiting sibling preference to concurrently enrolled students.

items.title: Report on Universal Design Emergency Preparedness Committee
items.summary: Kathleen Medaglio and Melanie McLaughlin presented safety recommendations for students with disabilities, leading the committee to request that the superintendent evaluate forming a district-wide emergency preparedness committee.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: The committee expressed condolences to the families of former teacher Robert Stenberg and Thomas Kreatz.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: The committee voted to enter executive session to discuss negotiations and legal matters.
